values.meaning: time in range before speed starts building
values.quote: builds up over 1 second while in range for at least {{fd|0.4}} seconds
values.binNote: not present as a distinct data value in this sheet excerpt

values.meaning: time out of range before speed begins decaying
values.quote: decays {{tt|at the same rate|See notes}} once out of range for at least 3 seconds

mechanics.claim: Casting an ability or entering champion combat puts Rock Surfing on cooldown, preventing the speed buff from building.
mechanics.quote: If '''Taliyah''' is casting an {{tip|ability}} or enters [[combat status|champion combat]], ''Rock Surfing'' cannot occur again for a few seconds.

mechanics.claim: Dealing default or proc damage does not interrupt or put Rock Surfing on cooldown.
mechanics.quote: Dealing {{tip|default damage|default}} or {{tip|proc damage|proc}} damage does not put ''Rock Surfing'' on cooldown.
